rationale: Best-supported call is non-AI: the identified CA Performance Management / DX NetOps function is described as monitoring, storing, analyzing, and displaying infrastructure performance and faults; no product-specific AI feature was established. The Broadcom product page was inaccessible as content (cookie/download shell), and current AI evidence found concerned a separately named DX Application Performance Management product. Available operational documentation does not substantiate full included-feature coverage, so this is weak and forced, not a claim that no AI exists.
version_scope: Record has no release date/version. VA describes DX NetOps Performance Management, identified as the new name for CA SPIM; mapping that to record's CA Performance Management is strong product-line context but not exact version proof.
issues: Official Broadcom documentation page returned only cookie/download shell; full product functionality and historical version could not be established.
A similar-name Broadcom DX APM result was not treated as evidence for this group.

sources.excerpt: DX NetOps Performance Management monitors, stores, analyzes, and displays information for assuring service quality across large, complex, multi-technology, multi-vendor network infrastructure. ... DX NetOps Performance Management is the new name for CA Systems Performance for Infrastructure Managers (SPIM).
